question: Why does a 30% drop to $142.39 still fail our buy gates and trigger an immediate exit on held shares?

epigraph.quote: Electricity is the foundation of economic growth, human well-being and national competitiveness. [3]
epigraph.author: K.R. Sridhar, Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer

web_blocks.html: Bloom Energy builds and services solid-oxide onsite power systems for data centers and factories. Q3 2026 sales jumped 138.1% year over year to $1.236 billion with $4.5 billion full-year guidance [2][3]. Yet nine-month cash flow after PP&E was only $41.585 million, turning negative (-$20.5M to -$22.2M) excluding a one-time $37.2M tariff refund and $26.6M affiliate investments [2]. Our Pass 1 audit keeps business quality at CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL (PASS_WITH_WATCH). Two customers drove 66% of 9M sales, supplier commitments reached $5.8 billion, Oracle warrants left $306.5 million in revenue offsets, and warranty reserves jumped 251% [2].

web_blocks.takeaway: Both new capital and held shares face clear, rule-bound verdicts: reject fresh buys on valuation and Stage 4 trend, and exit the 39.795672 held shares after breaching the $150.34 stop.

web_blocks.html: Valuation shows why a 29.5% slide since November 12 is not a buy signal. At $142.39 ($42.43 billion basic EV; $46.47 billion diluted EV), Bloom trades at 9.43 to 10.33 times guided sales and 88.21 times trailing earnings [55][56][57]. Our ten-year DCF puts Bear value at $13.50, Base value at $75.98 (stressing down to $38.13–$53.24), and Bull value at $243.88 using an equalized 10.0% WACC [2][3]. Expected value is $76.17 per diluted share, sitting 46.5% below spot. Reverse-DCF math shows $142.39 prices in over 25% annual sales growth for ten years even at a 15% FCF margin.

Technicals confirm heavy selling pressure. The facts ledger still prints Stage 1 because the 50-day SMA ($234.02) stays above the 200-day SMA ($223.89) [57]. However, the Stage 2 evaluator assigns STAGE_4 (CAP_REJECTED) across weekly, daily, and 4-hour charts [55]. Closing at $142.39 ($142.45 TradingView) on 1.57 times volume broke the retired November 12 band ($158.76–$163.60) and $150.34 stop [55][57]. With BE REJECTED (TIER_0), no buy band exists above fair value; conditional re-evaluation begins only below Base DCF ($53.24–$68.00) alongside trend and FCF repair. Breaching $150.34 mandates EXIT_IMMEDIATELY on all 39.795672 held shares ($5,666.51 value; 7.54% weight), keeping 100% of proceeds in cash [53].

web_blocks.title: Bottom Line for Owners & New Capital
paragraphs: Bloom Energy addresses a real power bottleneck, yet cash conversion lags sales and the stock sits in Stage 4 below its $150.34 stop. Reject new capital (TIER_0). Exit all 39.795672 held shares immediately after checking live quotes and tax lots. Hold 100% of the estimated $5,666.51 proceeds in cash.

book_paragraphs: Welcome to the refreshed monograph on Bloom Energy as of November 20, 2026. You can respect Bloom's sales growth and still refuse to own the stock after its stop breaks. Q3 sales surged 138 percent to $1.236 billion, yet nine-month cash after PP&E was $41.6 million and turns negative once a one-time $37.2 million tariff refund and $26.6 million affiliate outlays are excluded. Our blind Pass 1 audit reaffirmed CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL quality after finding $5.8 billion in take-or-pay supplier commitments, 66 percent two-customer concentration, tripled warranty reserves, and $306.5 million in Oracle warrant offsets.

At $142.39 ($142.45 TradingView), Bloom fell nearly 30 percent since November 12, yet valuation stays tight. Our ten-year DCF puts Base value at $75.98 per diluted share (stressing down to $38.13 on a 6 percent margin or $53.24 at a 12 percent WACC) and probability-weighted expected value at $76.17 using an equalized 10 percent Bull WACC, roughly 46.5 percent below spot. Justifying $142.39 takes more than 25 percent annual revenue growth for a decade at a 15 percent terminal FCF margin.

Meanwhile, the chart broke into Stage 4. Price sits 39 percent below a falling 50-day average and 41 percent below the 30-week average, cutting through our $150.34 stop. New capital is REJECTED at TIER_0 with no live buy zone above Base DCF ($75.98). Our 39.795672 held shares ($5,666.51 value, $8,999.96 cost) trigger EXIT_IMMEDIATELY. Verify live quotes and lots, exit the full holding, and keep 100 percent of proceeds in cash during the S&P 500 correction.

book_callouts.title: NARRATOR'S REFLECTION
book_callouts.text: Price discipline means acting when your stop breaks, not moving the goalposts lower. Exit the breached position, keep the cash liquid, and let future cash conversion earn back your attention.
